lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five discernible vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters are positioned posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a semi-regular grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, creating a lattice-like appearance where the spots serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, beginning above the gill slits and extending posteriorly, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two high-chroma yellow pixel clusters (consistent with commensal fish) located near the ventral-posterior margin of the gill slits and beneath the pectoral fin.
